# Coin-Oid

> Free AI-powered identification tool for coins, banknotes, medals and tokens. Upload a photo and Coin-Oid (Old Penny) identifies it, grades it, and gives a value estimate. Ask Old Penny anything about numismatics, fakes, grading, or metal detecting finds. Part of the FeelFamous -Oid Ecosystem.

Live at: https://coin-oid.co.uk

## Core tool (free, no sign-in required)

- Photo identification, grading and valuation of coins, banknotes, medals and tokens.
- Ask Old Penny — a chatbot voiced as a 68-year-old East London market trader, on hand at the Portobello Road coin stalls since he was 12. Answers questions about numismatics, fakes, grading, and metal detecting finds.
- A "roast" mode gives Old Penny's market-stall verdict on your coin instead of a formal identification.
- Meet tab — a what3words-based meeting point generator for coin fairs.

The identification tool, the chat, and roast mode are all free forever, with no sign-in wall and no paid tier required.

## Membership (Patreon — optional, supports hosting, does not gate the tool)

- Villager — £4.95/month
- Elder — earned, not bought
- Founder — £14.95/month

Membership funds a hosted hut/hamlet page, kudos, leaderboard and activity feed — none of it is required to use the identification tool or Old Penny.
